title: USG architect freedom concept illustration
summary: Concept illustration expressing the idea that USG can free architects from tool-specific CAD/BIM workflows and reconnect architectural intent with sketching. The image contrasts rigid software dependency on the left with free sketch-based design on the right, using USG as the transition layer. This is communication/positioning material, not canonical protocol evidence and not a technical design input.
concepts: architectural intent should not be trapped inside a specific CAD/BIM tool
USG acts as a software-neutral bridge between human sketching and downstream production systems
sketching remains a valid high-bandwidth design interface
software should execute structured intent rather than dictate the creative process
tool-specific complexity should move downstream and become increasingly invisible to the architect
